nom: CeraVe Skin Renewing Vitamin C Serum

avis.titre: Okay product at first but oxidizes readily
avis.texte: This product was okay at first, but I found that it oxidizes pretty readily throughout the day and leaves orange-tinted spots behind. For reference, I usually apply after rinsing my face in the morning, let it soak in for about a minute, then apply a moisturizer followed by sunscreen. It might be due to the high concentration of vitamin C but the product lacking good stabilizers in the formula, but I'm not a chemist or dermatologist so not sure. Would recommend only using at night if you do use it.
It was in poor condition; the texture had a yellowish hue, unlike its usual color, and the exterior was stained with a rust-colored liquid.
Not particularly moisturizing. Didn't notice any difference. But no bad smell or taste

I was using the skin better vitamin C serum and didn't want to repurchase with that big price tag. Saw good reviews on this and had a coupon; will not buy again. The cap has to be twisted and pushed on, which dispenses excess product all over. Oxidizes on face, and peels. Please, save your money!
I love my cerave face wash and lotion, but this did nothing for my skin compared to other vitamin c serums. I'm guessing it was bc of the low 10% vitamin c in it. Would not repurchase.

avis.titre: If you wear makeup daily, stay away
avis.texte: It makes your makeup peel off like crazy! (Regardless of how long you wait for it to dry)

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] For eye creams to be effective when it comes to nourishing I feel like it needs to be much thicker than this product actually is. My first impression wasn't great and I don't know that I'll grab for it again.

I have combination to dry, sensitive skin and have been using this vitamin C serum in the morning for a few weeks. I like that it feels light and has a serum-like texture that spreads easily, making it comfortable to wear. I usually follow up with other products to seal it in, which helps my skin feel hydrated throughout the day. The biggest issue for me, as someone with very pale skin, is that the serum causes certain areas to turn orange after a few hours. This usually happens near my hairline and eyebrows and is very noticeable, almost like smudges of food on my face. I have tried using only a tiny amount, patting it on instead of spreading, and even avoiding those areas, but the discoloration still appears. That said, after using it consistently for a while, I have noticed that my skin looks more radiant and has a healthy glow. Additionally, the serum comes in a convenient squeeze tube, though sometimes the first bit is already slightly oxidized, which feels wasteful (I might try storing it in the fridge). Overall, the serum works well, but the visible orange tint on pale skin is a major drawback.

I've tried quite a few Vitamin C serums, this one makes my skin feel soft and velvety and soaks in well. No pilling or reaction with moisturizer. My skin feels velvety softy and noticeably brighter. I rarely review or stan a product but this one is good. The new packaging also helps prevent oxidization.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love using this product with the other skin renewing products. I rub it over my entire eye and I don't feel I need to comfort or smells that would make me want to cry like I've had a car another products.

avis.titre: Perfect Morning Companion to My CeraVe Retinol Eye Cream
avis.texte: I've been using CeraVe's Retinol Eye Cream at night and it has worked wonders for smoothing and firming my under-eye area. I wanted something to complement it in the morning, and this Vitamin C Eye Cream is exactly what I needed. It brightens my eyes instantly, absorbs quickly without feeling greasy, and layers perfectly under sunscreen and makeup. After a few weeks, my eye area looks more refreshed and even-toned throughout the day. It's the ideal day-and-night duo!

Sadly this didnt work for me. I've been using it twice a day since December 29, 2024. I haven't noticed my skin brighten at all nor has my sister notifed a difference either. I did develop some tiny small bumps when I first applied to my face, but they quickly went away the more I used it. It does apply on smooth. I put it own before my moisturizer. I was hoping to brighten areas on my face where I have Hyperpigmentation and acne scars. I'm also an African American woman if thst helps.

no matter how long you let this sit and dry itll still pill. i cant even use it most days that i wear makeup because my makeup clumps up. seriously i cant believe i paid this much for something so bad. never again!

I love Cerave products and have tried the Vitamin C serum 3 times. Each time, the serum oxidized (became csramel on color) after only using about 2/3 of the tube. When a Vitamin C serum oxidizes, it's no longer effective on your skin. With the amount of product I'm throwing away, I'm losing money. I might as well buy a more expensive product that will last longer.
Don't waste your money on this product. It will make you look like you have dandruff and flaky skin due to the amount of peeling.
I use Cerave moisturizer so I was excited to try this however I'm not noticing any results and it pills under water based sunscreen or foundation.

For someone with dry skin, it has been really hard to find a vitamin C product that doesn't dry out and irritate my skin. This is the only one I found that I actually like, and I see a real difference in the texture and overall tone of my skin. It's also fairly priced. I like it so much that I felt like I had to spread the gospel after seeing the negative reviews here. It also lays nicely under makeup for me, I apply it in the morning and then proceed with my routine and haven't had any issues.

This product is fantastic paired with my Olay Complete Moisturizer. I don't understand all the reviews talking about pilling. It does nothing of the sort. My routine (2x per week): 1. CeraVe Moisturizing Toner 2. CeraVe Vitamin C 3. Olay Complete Moisturizer SPF 30 Sensitive (or CeraVe Daily Moisturizer if applying at night) 4. CeraVe Renewing Eye Cream On no vitamin c days, i skip numbers 1 & 2. I am 35 yrs old with great skin. Thanks to these products. *oh and the packaging has improved. Much easier to dispense down to the last drop and able to stand upright in cabinet (instead of laying down and being very much in the way) 👍🏼
Great product that actually works over time. I can really see a difference in my face.

I wanted to love this and I went through half a tibe before i finally accepted the fact that is was just not a good product. It pills on my skin so badly once i topped it with moisturizer, everything would jusy start to peel off.
This didnt do anything to improve my skin just very blah. It was more of a moisturizer texture versus a serum. It felt like it sat on top of my skin instead of absorbing into it.
My hairline, eyebrows, neck, and in between my eyebrows became yellow while using this.

I was so excited about this product and I like most of the products from CeraVe, but I was so disappointed. It pills! I tried it with different sunscreens, different moisturizers, and even changed the order of my routine to see if it made a difference but no luck.

Normally I'd 10/10 recommend CeraVe products, but not this one. I've been using this serum for a couple of weeks and the only difference I notice is it turns orange on my skin making it look like I did a poor blending job of makeup. Thumbs down for me.

avis.titre: New tubing aging the vitamin c quicker
avis.texte: Have been using for over a year and am not a fan of the new packaging. When Vitamin C ages it turns an orange dark color. After a couple of uses and securing the cap back on every time I noticed the product starting to change color, so I would see if the new plastic tube is causing g it rather than the metal tubing before

I'm 29 years old and decided I needed a skincare regimen. I have dry, sensitive skin, and wanted to start an anti-aging skincare regimen. I tried another brands skincare products, and after prolonged use, I was breaking out with little bumps (not acne) on my cheeks. I knew I needed something for sensitive skin. I used the Cerave quiz and went and bought what they recommended. This is just one of the recommended products... After the first night of using Cerave, the little bumps were already disappearing! After a few rounds of using the recommended skincare from Cerave, I notice my dark circles are lighter! If you have sensitive skin, look no further than the Cerave brand, no matter how many products are recommended to you by people you know. Cerave truly is for sensitive skin, and it has saved my skin, and it's also doing the job I wanted for my skin in the very beginning.

This product is amazing!!! I use it every day in my morning skincare routine, and I have really noticed a difference in my skin being more hydrated. This is a great serum to incorporate into any skincare routine!

avis.titre: Not to be used with spf, it pills and they know it
avis.texte: Pills horribly under the facial lotion spf30, I called the hotline and they said don't use together, but both are to be use during the day. The majority of both products will crumb off the skin, leaving it unprotected. All the way bummed.

The packaging of this C Serum is perfect. I noted That First, when looking around the CeraVe aisle. This is crucial for stability the of the ingredients. I went ahead and purchased this C Serum, and could not be more pleased with the results. In the past I have only used "high end" serums, moisturizers and such.\ Not any more...I'm in on the entire CreaVe line of products!!

Obviously, I loved this product to the very last drop! It was a nice, no-fuss vitamin-c serum that left my skin so glowy and clear. It's a pretty runny formula, so you have to be careful as it comes out, but it glides on the face easily and sinks into the skin like a dream. This did stain a bit, so just be careful with what you're wearing while applying it. Overall, I was pleased with this budget-friendly serum.

As someone with mature skin, finding a serum that truly delivers on its promises is like discovering a hidden treasure. From the moment I incorporated this serum into my skincare routine, my skin felt like it had sipped from the fountain of youth. The glow it imparts is nothing short of magical. Fine lines appear softened, and my complexion radiates vitality. The intense hydration leaves my face plump, dewy, and oh-so-touchable. It's like a spa day in a bottle.Dark spots and uneven tone? Sayonara! With consistent use, my skin looks more even, and those pesky age spots are fading away. It's like Photoshop for real life. My skin texture has undergone a delightful makeover. Pores appear minimized, and the overall canvas feels smoother. Makeup glides on effortlessly, and I'm one step closer to that flawless finish.

avis.titre: Works wonderfully¡. I will continue to buy it over
avis.texte: Worked wonderfully I love this stuff! Will continue to buy it over again!

I've repurchased this product probably 4 times now and I absolutely love it. Evens out skin tone, makes my skin feel so smooth, and has helped fade acne scarring. My only gripe with the product was always the packaging. It was metal and would break open easily. Love the new packaging!!!!
I appreciate that Cerave products are fragrance free but this product smells so bad, I will not buy it again.

I love this serum. I've been using it for years now alongside Cerave's retinol, and my skin glows. The one major downside.. the tube's quality is HORRIBLE. I keep it in a toiletry bag with my other skincare supplies, and within a month or 2, there are holes in the metallic tube at weak/bending points and the product leaks out. I still have half a tube left and am forced to wrap tape around the end to prevent the serum from being spoiled by light exposure and leaking everywhere. I really wish they would use stronger packaging.

avis.titre: Vit C serum - Not Fragrance-Free anymore
avis.texte: I've been using this vit C serum for years and I'm very satusfied and happy with this product not only bec it's good for my skin but also it's fragrance-free. I just recently placed an order again and twice I did return it. There was a powdery smell on the serum when I applied it. I ordered twice on different stores just to make sure it was legit. But I returned the items twice too bec they both smell like powder when I applied it on my skin. I hope Cerave company will bring back the original Fragrance free Vit. C Serum. This is very important to me bec I'm allergic to scents.
I highly recommend this Vitamin C Serum. I trued to use different brand but keep coming back to this one. Its very lightweight on your skin.
I had the worst reaction from this. It literally burned off my skin!!!

I really enjoy the texture of this. I see a few reviews mentioning it pills under sunscreen/makeup but I have not had that happen. I will say though, I always let each product sit at least 10 minutes before adding another to really allow it time to penetrate the skin, so maybe thats why I don't experience the pilling.
Hand down, best vitamin C serum I've tried! Melts into the skin, smooth hydrating finish. My acne scarring has lightened immensely! Love this!

I really can't tell a difference yet. I'm using this product and nightly exfoliation which I can use about 4 times a week, daily moisturizing, skin renewing night cream, hydrating facial cleanser and was using the eye cream but I gave that to my daughter. Price is about right. I'm trying for a bit longer and decided to try the vitamin c serum. Going to the dermatologist I'll find out what she thinks. I also have the healing ointment which I like.

I've been using this product for about a week now and so far so good. I like the packaging and I love the feel of this on my skin. It's a smooth application and a little goes a long way. I will say after reading the other reviews, I'm not sure if I'll actually notice a difference in my skin. We'll see, but overall I think this is a good product and fairly affordable compared to other vit c.

I have used this for over a month a frw times a week The next few days after use a thin layer of my skin peels off My be good to keep skin healthy but makeup come off with skin so you have to srubb you face and reapply makeup

Greatest product for my mature, dryer skin. I noticed a major difference in the smoothness, glow, and hydration after just a few applications. Wish I would have tried this sooner!!! Can't wait to see what the long term results will be! Helpful hint: when I apply anything, I always wet my fingers first. I really believe it helps with spreading and absorbing, and just feels great. Do not hesitate to try this Vitamin C Serum.

avis.titre: Is it safe to use if it looks orangish in color?
avis.texte: I have been a fan of Cerave products for 1 year as they have greatly improved my skin. I recently bought the Vitamin C serum from Cerave about 2 weeks ago but the package immediately cracked at the bottom. I am so disappointed about this. The vitamin C was already orangish before I even used it. I am not sure if it is safe because it is oxidized. And yet I bought it ver expensively. It also smells like bread.

I was super excited to find a vitsmin c product that was affordable. Well I used it and my skin is blotchy with orange and red spots now assuming im allergic to this product. Also so bummed that they are not animal cruelty free. I will mo longer be supporting this brand :(

avis.titre: ? Unsure if it's protecting my skin or not
avis.texte: Not sure if it does anything but it's not irritating to my skin. Feels nice to put on. No scent. Doesn't leave a sticky feel. Not a big fan of the packaging. Hard to get it all out. My skin is looking great but don't know if this is playing a roll or how effective it might be.

avis.titre: Vitamin C and Hyaluronic Acid in one serum!
avis.texte: I've been using this serum for over a year now. It absorbs well and doesn't feel sticky or greasy. Has no smell at all which could be a bad thing or a good thing ( depending on your preference). I love that it has hyaluronic acid so you're getting 2 great skin care ingredients in one serum!

CeraVe's 10% Vitamin C Serum is my go-to for brightening my skin. The high vitamin C concentration works wonders for a more radiant complexion. The serum's effectiveness and quality make it a worthwhile investment. If you're looking to add brightness to your skin, CeraVe's 10% Vitamin C Serum is a solid choice that has become a staple in my skincare regimen. It's a reliable choice to start vitamins c journey.

I started using this product about a year ago. Ever since my skin has been glowing! It has a orangey citrus smell, and the texture isn't sticky like other serums i've tried! The only downside is the packaging can be a tad annoying, but other than that I recommend!
Improved the tone and texture of my skin quickly without causing any added irritation. Makes my skin look more refreshed in the mornings when I use it.

I have used about half of the container but did not realize it was this product causinh the piling. The first week or so it does fine. I then started to notice that the moment i used my sunscreen or foundation everything rubs off. I changed sunscreens, foundations, moisturizer, etc. nothing stopped jt. My skin looks so dry because of it. Once I stopped using it, my skin didnt have any problems.

I was very excited to try this product — I had stopped using a Vit C serum ($$$) and was ready to get back to one at a more affordable price point. I opted for the Cera Ve because it had great reviews. This product worked for me for about 2 weeks, and I was really enjoying it. I quickly noticed it was oxidizing on my skin, making it look yellow and would take a few washes to come off completely. Stained my towels, makeup brushes, etc. It also started leaking from the base of the cap, which leads me to believe that its oxiding even faster inside the packaging because there is air getting inside at all times. I wanted to love it, but I'm going to return it and opt for another brand.

avis.titre: No need to go super expensive with your vitamin C
avis.texte: This vitamin serum is my go to. My skin is pretty sensitive to new serums but gave me no problems with this. My skin tone is more balanced now, a little goes a long way with this, and is a smooth application.

CeraVe's Skin Renewing Vitamin C Serum is a very nice serum. The lightweight yet potent formula has visibly brightened my complexion and evened out my skin tone. The addition of ceramides ensures hydration, making it suitable for daily use. I appreciate its non-irritating nature, and my skin feels more radiant and rejuvenated since incorporating this serum into my routine. Highly recommended for a boost of radiance!

It pills like crazy on me! I only used this product in the AM thinking my sunscreen was the issue but it's this serum. Adding another product definitely makes the pilling worse though. I would not recommend.

avis.titre: Each product delivers results as stated by the company, e...
avis.texte: CeraVe products are all amazing on my sensitive skin. All the products have shown me results as described, unlike other companies that attempt to sell you something that ends up with no results or a break out, never with CeraVe.

Honestly my skin is so sensitive that I doubted trying this but after a week of use I am glowing and my tone is more even. The product itself feels so great on my skin with no fragrance. Highly recommend

This really does brighten and give a shine to the skin that wasn't there before after you've stayed consistent with use. I'd be careful how/where you store this though because if it gets pinched/smashed in any way the metal tube leaks. Be sure to replace this product because it separates and expires! Great product from cera ve!
It really does give your skin a youthful glow, just smells. I'm of melanin skin too works great for dark spots as well

avis.titre: This stuff works for dark spots!
avis.texte: I am olive skinned and i have some freckles that came about from sun damage (I wasn't born with freckles). I have used this for two weeks and there is already significant lightening of these spots. They are fading and this product is the only change in my routine. My skin looks more even toned. I couldnt be happier! It makes me want to try other Cerave products!

I've been using CeraVe Vitamin C Serum for over a year now and it has vanished my sun spots and given my skin a wonderful glow. I keep it in the fridge and have never had an issues using this product or it turning color. Beautiful and potent vitamin C! Highly recommend!

My dermatologist recommended Cerave Skin Renewing Vitamin C to minimize facial dark spots. After using once a day for two months I did notice improvement in diminishing dark spots. A small amount of product goes a long way. I liked the fragrance and texture. It can be used under makeup. This product seems to dry out your skin so I added additional moisturizer.

I use this vitamin c serum as a substitute for retinol follow with my cerave renewing night moisturizer since retinol can't be use during anytime of a pregnancy. I'm in my second trimester and this pregnancy has cause me so much drying... before my pregnancy I have combination skin.

I LOVE this product. The packing is terrible. it leaks. Yes, I opened it correctly. We traveled this past weekend. It leaked over other products and now ruined those products. Ruined a makeup bag. Just sad. Again, packaging aside, great product.

avis.titre: Vitamin c is a must have in skin care
avis.texte: CeraVe's Skin Renewing Vitamin C Serum is a skin care product that everyone should consider making a staple in their skin care routine. It's made with 10% vitamin C which helps to brighten dark spots and hyperpigmentation. Plus it contains hydrologic acid which is great because vitamin c does not work the way it's supposed to if it's not used in conjunction with hydroclonic acid and vice versa. Really love about this serum: Pro's - *suitable for all skin types - Absorbs ultra fast - - *produces visible results. - * boosts skin's radiance - *Fights free radicals Cons - *Potentially could make breakouts a little more frequent or worse specifically for people who have naturally oily complexions and are prone to breakouts. - *Although this product is good for all skin types it could cause extra sensitivity so you may want to ease into using the serum This is a high quality vitamin c serum and we should all have a good vitamin c element in our skin care routine.

avis.titre: Simple and easy vitamin c for starters
avis.texte: I'm new to vitamin c, but I've really enjoyed this. I've been using it every morning after washing my face, and I follow up a serum and moisturizer. There's no smell, which is nice. Sometimes it comes out a tad darker (but I think it has to do with exposure to air). I do hate the pointed cap. I wish it was flat so the product had a chance to stay propped up with my other items.

avis.titre: Affordable and gentil on the skin
avis.texte: This serum has been very gentle on my skin, I think the 10% concentration is ideal. The serum is very light and absorbs well. The price seems correct to me. I have been using it for about 3 weeks and until today I can say that my skin has accepted it and I have had no irritation. I notice that my face doesn't look as dull as before. It has no scent and the packaging seems perfect to me.

avis.titre: Disappointing changes in all the anti-aging line?
avis.texte: Was the recipe for this recently changed as well ? I have been using all the products from the purple Cerave line for years, but I have been extremely disappointed with my most recent refills. Like the day cream with SPF, the vit C serum is different in both texture and especially smell in a bad way. It's now thicker, greasier and has a very strong/artificial/sugary smell. Hoping they just dropped the perfume bottle in their most recent batch because I'm already looking for substitutes.

I have used this for two months. I have seen absolutely zero positive benefits from using this. However, I have noticed one negative side effect. The vitamin C causes rapid oxidation of my pores and I started having a lot of blackheads. I quit using it a week ago and have already noticed a reduction in blackheads. So, if you have large pores or are prone to blackheads, this is not the product for you!

avis.titre: The best value Vitamin C Serum for how AMAZING it works!
avis.texte: Amazing product to add to my face care routines. I searched a while and this was the best value vitamin C Serum I could find. Very minimal scent and glides easily across the face. Absorption is great and I can already notice a change in the evenness of my skin tone.

avis.titre: My skin is in its best form!
avis.texte: This is so effective! I decided to try it out because I heard good things about this product. My skin has never been better! The packaging is small but lasts a long time. The smell is not annoying, and the absorption is great! The texture is nice and soft. I love this product!

I loved this product. It brightens my face up and at a great price. It doesnt cost an arm and a leg like those other brands for their vitamin C serum. It's not sticky and light weight too. I only use cerave for my facile products.

avis.titre: I absolutely love the Creve Renewing Vitamin C Face Serum!
avis.texte: It has been a game-changer for my skincare routine. The serum feels lightweight and absorbs quickly, leaving my skin feeling refreshed and radiant. With consistent use, I've noticed a visible improvement in my skin's texture and overall brightness. I highly recommend this serum to anyone looking to incorporate Vitamin C into their skincare regimen for a healthy and youthful complexion.

I actually LOVE this product and there is no scent, until I've had it on about 30-60 minutes, then it smells very weird! The best way to explain the smell is somewhat "mechanical", the container is, I'm not sure, "metal" or "aluminum" which you can only see when the cap is off. I think that is where the smell is coming from. Honestly, this makes me sad, I'll have to return it to the store, the after smell, I guess it is, is so unpleasant, I can no longer use it. I'm sorry to give this type of review but I want the company to be aware.

Gentle enough for a beginner. Lasted three months in which the color only went from a light cream to a lightly mustard tinted cream. Still good so the tube worked on keeping it mostly airless. Lightened my cheeks enough that I can see the darker pigmentation that needs worked on now.
I have been using this product consistently for 6 months - my skin is bright and my acne scars are slowly fading! A must have in my daily routine

avis.titre: Great buy at a good price
avis.texte: This definitely and obviously helped with my pigmentation and fine lines. And it's in an air right tube so it doesn't turn brown and lose its strength. I've already bought my second tube.

I started using this serum a month back and saw great results in my skin. It looks brighter and cleaner - reducing discoloration. I love the product comes in tube form so the serim does not get exposed being vitamin c serum. Also the fact that it is 10% vitamin c is amazing!must to have in the mornjng skin care routine backed up by good sunscreen. Great product, great price! Totally worth it.

This is my second time trying Cerave Vitamin C Serum. The first one became yellow almost immediately, this one has become yellow almost as quickly. I keep it carefully closed, in a dark and cool environment. Also, it leaks out of the lower part of the top, beneath the ridge part of the top. It's hard to know if I'm using a product that works when it's already showing signs of oxidation. I have heard good things about this, but I am leery of using a yellow product when it is supposed to be white. And if it is leaking, I assume that means somehow there is a hole and it's getting oxygenated.
I purchased this product and after a couple weeks started noticing a metallic smell and it started oozing some of the oxidized rust into the serum. Would not recommend unless they fix the packaging

Higher content than mosy of the products ive found. Definitely higher vit c content than anything affordable. Brightens and lightens with out clogging pores. The only reason i took off a star is because the lid leaks a bit. Other than that ots practically perfect.

avis.titre: Finished the entire tube and no change in lightening dark...
avis.texte: I started using this product a few months ago because I wanted to incorporate a vitamin c into my daily routine - vit c, moisturizer, sunscreen. This one seemed the best priced with the most appropriate packaging. While it felt nice on the skin, it really had no effects on my dark spots. The tube also has a leak in it along the top so it would oxygenate the serum and turn it orange so I think it became ineffective because of that too. Overall wouldn't recommend this product and I'm on the lookout for another daytime serum to add to my routine.

this is a great vitamin C serum. I have tried how many vitamin C serum, and this is one of the best affordable ones I have tried. It brightens up my skin after use, and looks great in gluey. It is the best affordable option for a vitamin C serum, you can find!
Literally changed my skin with one tube. My skin is bright and glowing! I will purchase this product until the end of time!

avis.titre: Doesn't seem to be suitable for people of tan skin
avis.texte: If your completion is on the beige tan the sunscreen with has zinc in it tends to show and at time as for me it was always flaking off. Very embarrassing.

My favorite Cerave product - I have tried so many things from them and this is the inly thing I'm sticking with!! My first ever Vitamin C serum and I went with this one because I heard it's a good option for sensitive skin but still potent to help with acne scars. I did not expect this to be SO hydrating. My face is a lot less dull, my acne scars are reducing - not completely gone but def a lot better from before I started this product. Ever since I started this serum I feel like I have found my skin care routine that even though I'd love to try other products I'm just scared I would miss this. I will 100% be repurchasing and maybeee trying another vitaminC serum in the future. My favorite thing about this serum is that even though I have sensitive skin this serum is so hydrating and nourishing for my skin that it even helped with my skin barrier. The change in brightness, scars, etc is very light but also I haven't even finished the first container yet. I'm really happy with this product and can't wait to see the results of using it for a couple more months!!

I am a fan of other product from Cerave for 3 years. I have used Via C from Cerave for 3 months. But I have an experience with the package of Vit C. It cracked!!!!. I am so disappointed about this. I am not sure about the efficacy of Vit C because it is oxidized.

I know this product has mixed reviews due to the packaging (it is kind of awful), but I will say the product itself has been a huge game changer for my skin. I stopped using this serum for a few weeks (I got on a retinol kick) and noticed my skin getting much more blotchy. Worked this back into my routine and after 2 uses my skin was back to being radiant. I recommend!

avis.texte: I love this product works good but recently i found out that its not cruelty free and seeing what they fo to those animals i just cant support the brand any longer. It also balls up and ruins make and your skin care at times

avis.texte: I love this product works good but recently i found out that its not cruelty free and seeing what they fo to those animals i just cant support the brand any longer. It also balls up and ruins make and your skin care at times

avis.titre: A little goes a long way
avis.texte: I love this stuff. I put this on after I shower and it makes my skin smooth. A little goes a long way and it makes my face brighter and more healthy looking.

avis.titre: Male in his late 50s with sun damage.
avis.texte: I bought this product a few weeks ago with not a lot of expectations. I have to say that I am very happy with my moderate results. I have fair skin with a lot of sun damage especially on my forehead/brow. This serum has helped with red spots and bumps on my forehead while I still have some mild redness and smaller bumps it's great to see that the overall look is better. If you are a male I strongly encourage you to try this serum, you won't be disappointed.

This is a great serum. It made my face brighter and got rid of dark spots! It's also good for your skin if you live in a polluted area it protects your skin. Just don't put too much or your skin will feel oily.

I purchased this product with absolutely zero expectations. I use some prescription skin care items but I like to try new skin stuff and am usually disappointed. My skin is like a toddler..finnicky and difficult! Well, not this time! Sun spots have faded significantly, my skin is just brighter (I always heard people say that but never understood, until now!), and the tone is amazing. I am shocked! avis.titre: What is going on with this product? Big let down.
avis.texte: I will preface this by saying I use several Cerave products on a daily basis and I absolutely love them — they have done wonders for my skin. However, this one… I geuinely don't understand. My brand new product is already yellow-orange in color, has a strong smell of apple cider vinegar (or something similar — it smells very sour), and has left an orange tint and film on my skin. An hour after applying it, my hands (that I washed with soap after applying the product on my face) and my face smell like cheap self-tanning lotion. I have no idea what is going on, but this doesn't look safe or stable, not to mention the smell is unbearable. It's a shame, because my skin felt so soft after just one use, and I really wanted to like it, but I can't put up with this one. Very disappointed, especially considering the price.
Only been using for about two weeks but so far I'm really like this vitamin C.

I use other CeraVe products, and after hearing how good Vit C was for skincare routines I immediately purchased this one. I didn't expect it to smell the way it did, and the colour was a little orangey. After a few days of using it I started to notice a brownish residue near my hairline. A week later the product was coming out orange. As much as I love CeraVe, I'm afraid this Vit C isn't for me.

I've been searching for a vitamin C product that would work well with my dry, sensitive skin, and I'm glad to have found this serum. It's still too early to see major changes or transformative results, but I have noticed that the serum feels hydrating on my skin during application. I'm looking forward to continuing my use of this product and seeing how it further benefits my skin over time.

avis.titre: Works fine, but unideal packaging=problems. NEXT
avis.texte: I like Vitamin C and have usually seen improvements to skin tone and evenness after using it. This one from CeraVe is no exception with the added bonus of being a company I trust. Price seems comparable to me to other Vitamin C serums that I've bought and which have been effective. The con for me of this product, and the reason I will *avoid* buying it unless this changes, is the packaging. The metal tube is brittle; it's not friendly to travelling; it is difficult to get every last bit of the serum out; and both times I've bought it, I've had to handle it VERY gently, otherwise the tube cracks, which wastes the product, and allows the product to oxidize. This stuff is comparable to other Vit C price-wise, like I said earlier, but it is not cheap enough for me to be okay with product spoilage. Now, I'd deal with this drawback if the packaging allowed for improved recyclability, but it doesn't even do that! A metal tube with a long plastic nozzle is not even recyclable around me, making this less recyclable than other options, which matters as someone who tries to be semi-conscious AND conscientious as a consumer :/ Keep it up with the formulas, CeraVe, but with this one, unless packaging changes, for me, it's not worth the investment and energy.

This is pretty good for a drugstore brand-- I used this for a few months and saw some brightening effects on my oily sensitive skin, especially when I used it while my face was still damp (right after washing) and before my moisturizer. My dark spots only lightened a small amount and there was only a slight improvement in my fine lines. The texture is like a serum, very light and absorbs quickly. It's an affordable option with ok results. I would still prefer Kbeauty or more high-end Vit C's. One thing I wish they'd improve is the tube-- it gets really hard to squeeze out the last bits of product near the end, since the tube is kind of a harder, malleable plastic? Feels like there's a lot of product left even after I can't squeeze any more.

I have been using vitamin c under my sunscreen for 20 years now and it works when formulated correctly. The best vitamin c serum available is $182 and I refuse to pay it so Ive been on the hunt for a reasonable replacement. The "shelf stable" vitamin c serums are not as effective along with these serums that dont tell you the percentage in the product. 10% L Ascorbic Acid is effective and fairly gentle. I finally tried this one and it works! The tube packaging is great. The effects stay active in your skin for 72 hours. It makes my skin smoother and brighter. I highly recommend this serum! I wear this everyday… urea toner, niacinimide, this 10% vitamin c and spf 50. I am 46 years old, no fine lines except the eyes, no sun damage or sun spots. I am so happy I tried this one! This is a good product.
